title: Cheap physical/chemical screening (gate before the bench)
description: Stage contract for the cheap physical/chemical screen that runs BEFORE the bench (PRECISION_GREASE_DEV inner loop). The bench is the bottleneck: about 2 positions per round and roughly 30 days per round, so cheap, fast tests exist to reject obviously-unqualified samples before they consume the scarce bench slots. Known limitation, recorded deliberately: physical/chemical indices usually have LOW discrimination power between close candidate formulas -- this stage is a gate, never a selection criterion, and a PASS means only 'not obviously unqualified', never 'better'. Fail-closed, encoded in the if/then below: overall_verdict=FAIL forces gate_to_bench=BLOCKED, because a failed screen must never reach the bench.

allOf.$comment: A failed screen must not reach the bench: the bench is the scarcest resource in the inner loop, so FAIL forces gate_to_bench=BLOCKED.

sample_reference.description: The sample this screen was run on (batch-produced sample identity).

tests.description: One entry per screened index. Every intended index of the frozen screen must appear; a measurement that is not determined must be recorded as verdict INCONCLUSIVE, never silently omitted.

overall_verdict.description: Aggregate screen verdict. FAIL is what forces the bench gate closed via the if/then above.

measurement_replicates.description: Number of replicate measurements taken per index in this screen. Strictly positive.

gate_to_bench.description: Whether the sample is released into a bench slot. RELEASED is only legal when overall_verdict is not FAIL.
